decisions.reason: Official faculty directory uses Business Administration as a faculty grouping and curriculum includes Operations Management, but these pages do not establish a distinct operations academic unit or operations research faculty remit.

sources.note: Operations Management course appears in BBA curriculum; not treated as a department.
Business Administration faculty grouping and program directors verified.
Engineering department directory checked: civil/geological/environmental, computer science, electrical/computer, mechanical, mining/mineral, petroleum; no industrial engineering department listed.

limitations: Business Administration label remains unresolved: operations teaching alone does not establish a separate operations unit. More specific faculty or organizational evidence needed.
